author: M.P
title: Inician campaña de firmas dirigida a Noruega para proteger el río, territorio y biodiversidad de Pilmaiquen
content:
El 28 de agosto, los socios de Avaaz confirmaron que la empresa estatal noruega Statkraft había completado el llenado del embalse a pesar de años de oposición mapuche y acciones legales en curso. Pero esto está lejos de terminar. Los líderes mapuches viajarán pronto a Noruega para exigir una investigación y rendición de cuentas por las violaciones de sus derechos y soberanía. ¡Este es un momento crítico! Firma ahora y ayuda a que sus voces sean imposibles de ignorar.

El gigante energético estatal noruego está a punto de ahogar el corazón sagrado del pueblo indígena mapuche. La inundación podría comenzar en cualquier momento.

Para Millaray Huichalaf, una de las líderes espirituales mapuches más respetadas , el Pilmaiquén no es solo un río. Es parte del paisaje sagrado donde sirve a su comunidad y donde generaciones de su pueblo han honrado a sus ancestros.

Millaray y los mapuche Williche han luchado contra este proyecto durante años y ya han logrado lo que muchos creían imposible: obligar a Statkraft a abandonar una represa anterior y devolver tierras ancestrales robadas.

Ahora han llevado su lucha directamente a Noruega, presentando una demanda que exige al gobierno noruego que cumpla con sus propios compromisos en materia de derechos humanos.

Dado que Statkraft es una empresa estatal, la presión pública sobre los líderes noruegos podría hacer que seguir adelante sea demasiado costoso políticamente como para ignorarlo . Si miles de nosotros apoyamos hoy a los machi Millaray, podemos ayudar a detener las inundaciones antes de que el daño sea irreversible. ¡Firma ahora!

Como ciudadanos de todo el mundo, insistimos en que ordenen a Statkraft que suspenda de inmediato sus actividades en tierras mapuche, impida la inundación del sagrado Pilmaiquén y respete plenamente los derechos indígenas, incluidos los derechos al consentimiento libre, previo e informado, a la participación transparente y a la rendición de cuentas.

Únete a la campaña. Firma PINCHANDO AQUÍ

author: groundxero
title: ISRO Employees Warn Against Privatisation of Core Functions
content:
Employees’ associations of ISRO demand answers over plans to hand over launch-vehicle production, satellite manufacturing and launch infrastructure to private players, warning that ISRO risks being reduced to an “R&D boutique”


 


Groundxero Desk


 


A growing confrontation is emerging inside India’s space establishment over the future of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), with employees’, staff and scientists warning that the government’s drive to open the space sector to private capital could end up hollowing out the country’s premier publicly funded scientific institution.


 


In an unprecedented move, on September 4, nine service associations representing employees of centers / units under the Department of Space and ISRO, have written to ISRO Chairman V Narayanan demanding an official explanation of reported plans suggesting that ISRO could eventually move away from manufacturing launch vehicles and that more of its technologies and facilities could be transferred to private companies and public sector undertakings.


 


In the letter, accessed by Groundxero, the associations have sought clarity on the institutional arrangements under which publicly developed technology, testing facilities, launch complexes and know-how are being transferred or opened to private operation.


 


The immediate trigger for the letter was remarks made by Pawan Kumar Goenka, Chairman of the Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe), at the Business Today India @ 100 Economy Summit on August 21. Goenka reportedly said:


 


“Eventually, ISRO will not make any launch vehicles and will not manufacture any launch vehicles. That will all be done by the private sector or PSU

.

”


 


IN-SPACe was launched in 2020 by the Narendra Modi government to facilitate the entry of the private sector in to ISRO and space sector. Pawan Goenka, a former Mahindra and Mahindra automobile company executive, who head the effort to privatise the space sector since 2020, further said:


 


“They [ISRO]

 will not do any day in day out kind of satellites. They will do the satellites that are for special purpose, for orbits for scientific research or to develop new technology that will then get transferred to the private sector.”


 


The associations pointed out in the letter that there has been no official communication from the Department of Space explaining whether the reported policy has been formally approved, who approved it, how it will be implemented, and what it means for thousands of employees and future recruitment.


 


In the letter, they asked the ISRO chairperson to issue a “written clarification” on whether Goenka’s statements represent an “approved decision” of the government of India, the Space Commission or the Department of Space.


 


The associations make a distinction between legitimate commercialisation through NSIL and a much more consequential dismantling of ISRO’s own capabilities. They have specifically demanded clarity on the respective roles of NSIL and IN-SPACe in the transfer of technology, facilities and know-how to private entities.


 


From Public Institution to Technology Supplier to Private Players


 


For the employees’ associations, the issue is far larger than the outsourcing of a few manufacturing contracts to private players. The key concern is what will remain of ISRO as a public institution if the actual making and launching of spacecraft and launch vehicles is progressively removed from it.


 


The concerns come amid a wider policy shift towards commercialising India’s space sector and expanding the role of private capital. The employees’ associations do not reject private participation as such. What they challenge is the possibility that “private participation” is becoming a euphemism for the withdrawal of the public sector from the technological and industrial capabilities it painstakingly built over decades.


 


According to the letter, the process has already begun with the Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV), for which technology and production rights have been handed over to Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL). The associations say the technology transfer is proposed to be extended to the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV) and Launch Vehicle Mark-3 (LVM3). Routine satellite manufacturing could also move out of ISRO, while new launch infrastructure, including the Space Launch Complex at Kulasekarapattinam, is being opened to private entities …

author: Unknown
title: Zayıflama iğneleri tehlikeli mi? Bilim ne diyor, sağlıkçılar ne öneriyor?
content:
Kilo kaybı sağlayan ilaçlar, obezite tedavisinde önemli bir seçenek haline geldi. Ancak “zayıflama iğnesi” olarak bilinen bu ilaçlar masum birer kilo verme ürünü değil. Bilimsel çalışmalar etkili olduklarını gösterirken, ciddi yan etkiler ve yanlış kullanım riskleri de bulunuyor. İlaçların hekim değerlendirmesi ve yaşam tarzı değişiklikleriyle birlikte kullanılmasının ise önemi büyük.

Son yıllarda sosyal medyanın da etkisiyle kilo vermek isteyenlerin gündemine giren GLP-1 temelli ilaçlar, aslında başlangıçta özellikle tip 2 diyabetin tedavisinde kullanılan ilaçlar arasında yer alıyordu. Semaglutid ve tirzepatid gibi etken maddeler iştahı azaltıyor, tokluk hissini artırıyor ve kan şekeri düzenlenmesine yardımcı oluyor. Bu etkiler, obezite tedavisinde de kullanılmalarının önünü açtı.

Ancak bu ilaçları “hızlı kilo verme iğnesi” olarak görmek önemli bir yanılgı. Dünya Sağlık Örgütü (DSÖ), 2025'te yayımladığı kılavuzda semaglutid, tirzepatid ve liraglutid gibi GLP-1 ilaçlarının yetişkinlerde obezitenin uzun süreli tedavisinde kullanılabileceğini koşullu olarak önerdi. DSÖ, bunun yanında uzun dönem güvenlilik, tedavinin bırakılması sonrası ne olacağı, maliyet ve sağlık sistemlerinin bu tedavilere hazırlığı konusunda belirsizlikler bulunduğuna dikkat çekti.

Evet. Bu ilaçların kilo kaybı konusunda güçlü bilimsel kanıtları bulunuyor. Özellikle semaglutid ve tirzepatid, iştah ve enerji alımı üzerinde etkili olarak kişilerin daha az yemek yemesine yardımcı olabiliyor. Ancak alınan sonuç kişiden kişiye değişiyor ve ilaçların etkisi, tedavinin süresi ve kişinin yaşam tarzıyla yakından ilişkili.

Bu nedenle sağlık otoriteleri ilaçları diyet ve fiziksel aktivitenin alternatifi olarak değil, obezitenin kapsamlı tedavisinin bir parçası olarak değerlendiriyor. DSÖ de GLP-1 ilaçları kullanan obezitesi olan yetişkinlere yapılandırılmış sağlıklı beslenme ve fiziksel aktivite programlarının eşlik etmesini öneriyor.

Doğru hastada, uygun dozda ve hekim gözetiminde kullanıldığında bu ilaçların yararları ve riskleri klinik olarak değerlendirilmiş durumda. Ancak ciddi yan etki potansiyelleri nedeniyle gelişigüzel kullanılmaları güvenli değil.

En sık karşılaşılan sorunlar arasında bulantı, kusma, ishal, kabızlık, karın ağrısı, hazımsızlık gibi şikâyetler bulunuyor.

Bunların yanı sıra ilaçların resmi güvenlik bilgilerinde pankreatit, safra kesesi hastalıkları, böbrek hasarı ve ciddi gastrointestinal reaksiyonlar gibi daha önemli riskler de yer alıyor. Bazı hastalarda kan şekeri düşüklüğü ve diyabetik retinopati komplikasyonları da önem taşıyor.

Bu nedenle “yan etkisi sadece biraz mide bulantısı” şeklindeki yaklaşım doğru değil.

İlaçların etkili olabilmesi kadar doğru dozda kullanılması da önemli. Özellikle doktor kontrolü dışında kullanılan ürünlerde doz hataları ciddi problemlere yol açabiliyor. ABD Gıda ve İlaç Dairesi (FDA), onaysız veya bileşik olarak hazırlanan semaglutid ürünlerinde yanlış doz kullanımına bağlı olarak hastaneye yatış gerektiren vakalar bildirildiğini açıkladı.

Bildirilen sorunlar arasında şiddetli bulantı ve kusma, karın ağrısı, susuz kalma, pankreatit ve safra taşı bulunuyor.

Uzmanların en önemli uyarılarından biri de ilacın nereden temin edildiği. FDA, onaylanmamış semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünlerinin güvenlilik, etkinlik ve kalite açısından piyasaya çıkmadan önce kurumun değerlendirmesinden geçmediğini belirtiyor.

Daha da önemlisi, kurum sahte semaglutid ve tirzepatid ürünleri tespit edildiğini; bazı ürünlerin etiketlerinde gerçekte bulunmayan eczanelerin isimlerinin dahi kullanılabildiğini bildiriyor.

Bu nedenle sosyal medya üzerinden, internet sitelerinden veya doktor değerlendirmesi olmadan satılan ürünler ile ruhsatlı ilaçların aynı şey olmadığı unutulmamalı.

Bu ilaçların temel kullanım alanı obezite veya belirli koşullarla aşırı kiloluluk gibi tıbbi durumların tedavisi. Sırf birkaç kilo vermek isteyen sağlıklı bir kişinin sosyal medyada gördüğü bir ilaçla kendi kendine tedaviye başlaması doğru değil. Tedavi kararı verilirken kişinin kilosunun yanı sıra boyu, vücut kitle indeksi, eşlik eden hastalıkları, kullandığı ilaçlar, beslenme alışkanlıkları ve diğer sağlık koşulları birlikte değerlendirilmeli.

Ayrıca gebelik söz konusu olduğunda GLP-1 tedavileri kullanılmamalı; DSÖ'nün obezite kılavuzu da hamile kadınları kapsam dışında bırakıyor.

Burada da önemli bir ayrıntı var. GLP-1 ilaçlarının iştah üzerindeki etkisi tedavi sürdüğü sürece devam eder. Tedavi bırakıldığında iştahın yeniden artması ve …

An Unfortunate Dead End — On Universal Healthcare

The Path Forward — Creation and Disruption

Interlocking Fronts — A call to Solidarity with Other Movements

Lights, Camera, Action – Immediate Steps

To answer the question of why the December 4th execution of UHC CEO Brian Thompson happened seems easy. Denials, price gouging, and the health insurance industry at large. However, as one unravels the outpouring of stories and symbolism in its wake, one finds it difficult to wrestle into a specific activist program. The questions one runs into are so urgent, but so foundational, that they resist easy answers.

Who lives and who dies? Who is healed and who is hurt? Who takes resources and who loses them?

There are no quick fixes to this system’s problems. Even if you personally have good insurance coverage and good health, you have seen loved ones struggle to afford or access lifesaving care. You have seen the downstream effects of for-profit healthcare in rising costs, closed hospitals, under-staffing, wait times, bureaucratic obfuscation. You have seen people lose everything to cover cancer care, forced to choose between rescue inhalers and rent, while c-suites get rich off the blood in the streets. It is impossible to avoid the growing realization that there are no quick fixes to this system’s problems because this system is the problem.

This is a part of the reason the events of December 4th resonated across the globe. While the “united states” is particularly bad in this regard, paying substantially more for worse care, other countries still struggle. “britain” has such lengthy wait lists for gender affirming care that the system forces trans people out of the country. “canada” may have universal healthcare that makes public hospitals and clinics available, but even still, has increasingly privatized some care, leading to 17.5% of the population to significant medical debt,[1] and the healthcare regime also pushes disabled people toward assisted suicide programs.[2] In Cuba, healthcare is free but US sanctions manufacture health scarcity by blocking the flow of technologies and medications both to punish Cuba for fighting western imperial capitalism and as propaganda against free healthcare.[3]

Within the “united states”, attempts to revise policies for better health outcomes have met little success.4 This is because such attempts do not fundamentally change the power dynamic at play, so insurance companies and hospital corporations continue raising prices, deciding what care gets covered, and limiting available services regardless of what laws are passed or revoked. Reform is not the solution when the system kills for profit.

We do not want to simply renegotiate the terms of a hostage scenario. We want the power to no longer be hostages.

title: Planned Parenthood’s Funding Ban Ended — But Money Isn’t Flowing in Every State
content:
Standard federal Medicaid reimbursement should have automatically resumed in about three dozen states.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Last year’s federal ban on using Medicaid to pay Planned Parenthood might have ended, but its funding has not automatically resumed nationwide.

On July 4, 2025, President Donald Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill Act” barred federal Medicaid reimbursements for one year to nonprofit family planning organizations that both provide abortions and received more than $800,000 in Medicaid reimbursements between October 2022 and September 2023.

The Hyde Amendment already prohibits Medicaid coverage of abortion with rare exceptions; the 2025 provision blocked reimbursement for other preventive care services Medicaid normally covers, like contraception, cancer screenings, STI testing and treatment, and annual exams.

The law never named Planned Parenthood. However, its criteria were so narrow that, as the organization argued in court, they seemed written to target the reproductive health-care giant. Only two other family-planning chains — Maine Family Planning and Health Imperatives, in Massachusetts — lost their funding.

Officially, these organizations can once again bill Medicaid for covered services. But when I scanned the states to see the status of Planned Parenthood’s federal funding, I found a more complicated budgetary reality. Its affiliate clinics have resumed billing for Medicaid-covered reproductive health-care services in many places — but in other states, GOP lawmakers are finding new ways to starve it of cash.

After a year-long hiatus, standard federal Medicaid reimbursement should have automatically resumed in about three dozen states, based on a June 2026 report by the health policy research nonprofit KFF. These include the 11 Democrat-led states that spent their own funds to keep affected clinics open — among them California, Connecticut, Illinois, and Maine.

My research shows that Medicaid payments are also up and running in Republican-run Ohio and purple Pennsylvania, among other states.

Just because something should automatically happen, however, doesn’t mean it will.

A handful of states had already blocked Planned Parenthood’s participation in Medicaid programs before the federal government did — some for over a decade. Texas, Arkansas, Mississippi, Missouri, and South Carolina — all Republican strongholds — fall into this category.

Despite some litigation over their Planned Parenthood exclusions, neither the federal ban nor its expiration changed the status quo in these places. Prior to July 2025, Medicaid patients in these states could not use their coverage at any Planned Parenthood clinic for any service — not birth control, cancer screenings, STI testing, or annual OB-GYN exams. And they still can’t.

Planned Parenthood’s status in Iowa is more legally complicated.

In 2017, Iowa withdrew from the federally matched family-planning program and created a state-funded alternative — one that explicitly excludes abortion providers, though the Iowa Planned Parenthood clinics still appear to participate in Medicaid.

But multiple other states have seen their own, similar exclusion laws tied up in court. The Supreme Court’s 2025 decision in Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic, which held that Medicaid patients cannot sue states in federal court to see the provider of their choice, may bolster these exclusion efforts.

Medicaid’s “free choice of provider” provision generally allows Medicaid patients to receive care from any qualified provider willing to treat them, including Planned Parenthood. Medina did not change the law, but it removed the possibility of federal litigation to enforce it. This eliminated one of the principal ways patients had enforced this provision.

As a result, when a state excludes Planned Parenthood from Medicaid, it’s now harder for patients to challenge that decision. That has created the opportunity for states to revive exclusion laws previously blocked by federal courts.

For example, after Medina, Indiana moved to vacate a 2013 court injunction on its 2011 law excluding the organization from the state’s Medicaid program. The district court granted that request in July 2026. Planned Parenthood has appealed, but it remains suspended from Indiana’s Medicaid program until the Seventh Circuit rules.

title: EXPLAINER: Why mental health professionals want DepEd’s live shooter drill deferred
content:
Simulation drill during the National Safe Schools Summit and Safety Drill at the Manila Science High School last July 15, 2026. (Photo from the DepEd Facebook page)

Psychiatrists and child mental health specialists insist that preparedness and psychological well-being should not be treated as competing priorities.

MANILA — The Department of Education’s (DepEd) plans to conduct a nationwide simultaneous school safety drill for active attack incidents has drawn concern from mental health professionals, who warned that hyper-realistic active shooter simulations may cause psychological harm to learners while offering little evidence that they improve school safety.

In a joint statement released on August 22, the Philippine Psychiatric Association (PPA) and the Philippine Society for Child and Adolescent Psychiatry (PSCAP) called for the deferment of any simulation of a live shooter attack drill, saying school preparedness must remain trauma-informed and evidence-based.

The two organizations stressed that they support efforts to make schools safe and resilient but argued that the methods used to prepare students and school personnel matter as much as the goal itself.

The statement came in response to a DepEd memorandum dated August 12 directing schools nationwide to conduct a nationwide simultaneous school safety drill for active attack incidents.

The PPA and the PSCAP said active attack simulations differ significantly from routine drills for earthquakes, fires, and other emergencies.

The groups said schools regularly conduct disaster preparedness exercises because these activities teach practical responses to real emergencies without exposing learners to graphic or highly realistic depictions of violence.

They argued that live shooter simulations introduce a different level of psychological risk because they often recreate violent scenarios that place participants in situations resembling actual attacks.

According to the groups, these exercises can expose children and adolescents to fear, uncertainty, and distress that may linger long after the drill ends.

Mental health professionals based their position on studies and recommendations from medical, educational, and safety organizations.

The National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine reported in 2025 that available evidence remains insufficient to conclude that active shooter simulations improve safety outcomes.

The report also advised schools against using high-intensity drills and deceptive practices.

The PPA and the PSCAP cited a large-scale study published in 2021 that analyzed 54 million social media posts from 114 schools in the United States.

Researchers found a 42 percent increase in language associated with stress and anxiety after shooter drills.

The same study documented a 39 percent increase in language associated with depression.

Researchers found that these effects remained evident for at least 90 days after the exercises.

The organizations also cited a 2020 policy statement from the American Academy of Pediatrics, which cautioned against involving children and adolescents in high-intensity crisis simulations.

The academy said schools should never rely on deception when conducting emergency preparedness exercises involving young people.

The groups also referenced guidance released this year by the National Association of School Psychologists, the National Association of School Resource Officers, the American Academy of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, and Safe and Sound Schools.

The guidance recommended banning hyper-realistic simulations, requiring advance notice before drills, and involving school mental health professionals in planning and implementation.

Mental health experts said children process fear and traumatic experiences differently from adults.

The PPA and the PSCAP warned that realistic simulations can trigger strong emotional reactions among learners, especially those who have previously experienced violence, abuse, displacement, disasters, or other traumatic events.

The organizations noted that some learners may also have disabilities, sensory-processing needs, or mental health conditions that make them more vulnerable to distress during highly immersive drills.

Mental health professionals argued that schools should avoid preparedness measures that inadvertently create psychological harm while attempting to prevent physical harm.

The groups emphasized that protecting learners requires balancing …

title: Hastalar için tedavi ortamı hayati önemde
content:
İzmir – Kanser hastalarının tedavisinde kullanılan kemoterapi ve port uygulama odalarındaki fiziki ve teknik eksiklikler hem hastaların hem de sağlık emekçilerinin sağlığını tehdit ediyor. Sağlık ve Sosyal Hizmet Emekçileri Sendikası (SES) İzmir 1 No’lu Şube Eş Başkanı Hava Akçan, bazı birimlerde pencere ve yeterli havalandırma bulunmadığını, sitotoksik atık sistemlerinde eksiklikler olduğunu belirterek gerekli koşulların sağlanmasını istedi.

İzmir’de Ege Üniversitesi Tülay Aktaş Onkoloji Hastanesi, Dokuz Eylül Üniversitesi Hastanesi Onkoloji Enstitüsü, İzmir Tepecik Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi, İzmir Katip Çelebi Üniversitesi Atatürk Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi ile Dr. Suat Seren Göğüs Hastalıkları ve Cerrahisi Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi başta olmak üzere kamu ve üniversite hastanelerinde kanser hastalarına tedavi hizmeti veriliyor.

İzmir’de aktif olarak kemoterapi gören hasta sayısına ilişkin güncel ve il bazlı resmi veri bulunmuyor. Sağlık Bakanlığı bu verileri kamuoyuyla paylaşmazken, kanser tanısı alan her hastaya da kemoterapi uygulanmıyor. Hastalığın türü ve evresine göre cerrahi, radyoterapi, immünoterapi ve hedefe yönelik ilaç tedavileri de uygulanabiliyor.

SES İzmir 1 No’lu Şube Eş Başkanı Hava Akçan ise kentte her yıl ortalama 12 bin yeni kanser vakası görüldüğünü belirterek, “Bu kadar yüksek sayıda yeni vaka görülmesine rağmen kentte kaç hastanın aktif olarak kemoterapi tedavisi aldığına ilişkin elimizde net bir istatistik yok” dedi.

Kemoterapi ve port uygulama alanlarında yaşanan sorunlara ilişkin konuşan Akçan, bağışıklık sistemi baskılanmış kanser hastaları açısından tedavi ortamının hayati önemde olduğunu söyledi.

Sağlık emekçilerinden aldıkları bilgiler doğrultusunda port uygulama odalarında öne çıkan sorunları anlatan Akçan, “Ünitedeki arkadaşlarımızla da konuştuk. Port odasına ilişkin en temel sorunlardan biri odanın penceresinin olmayışı. Yeterli bir havalandırma sistemi de bulunmuyor. İğne atık kutusunun sitotoksik atık kategorisine uygun olmaması da diğer önemli sorunlardan biri” dedi.

Bir ünitede klimanın yaklaşık iki haftadır arızalı olduğunu aktaran Akçan, eksik parça gerekçesiyle sorunun giderilmediğini ve çalışanların küçük bir vantilatörle çalışmak zorunda kaldığını söyledi.

Kanser hastalarının bağışıklık sistemlerinin tedavi sürecinde son derece hassas olduğunu belirten Akçan, kemoterapi ve port uygulama alanlarının buna uygun düzenlenmesi gerektiğini ifade etti.

Akçan, “Kemoterapi ve port uygulama odalarının hem hastaların enfeksiyondan korunmasını sağlayacak hem de çalışanları sitotoksik ilaçların etkilerinden koruyacak şekilde düzenlenmesi gerekiyor. HEPA filtreli havalandırma sistemleri, sitotoksik ilaç döküntü kitleri, acil durum ekipmanları ve uygun çalışma koşulları sağlanmalı. Bunların eksikliği, zaten bağışıklığı baskılanmış hastaları ciddi enfeksiyonlara açık hale getiriyor” diye konuştu.

Sorunun yalnızca hastalar açısından değerlendirilmemesi gerektiğini vurgulayan Akçan, kemoterapi birimlerinde çalışan sağlık emekçilerinin her gün tehlikeli sitotoksik ilaçlarla temas ettiğine dikkat çekti.

Akçan, “Bu koşullar sağlık emekçilerinin sağlığını da doğrudan ilgilendiriyor. Tehlikeli sitotoksik ilaçlarla çalışan sağlık emekçilerinin gerekli koruyucu donanıma ve güvenli çalışma ortamına sahip olması gerekiyor. Aksi halde meslek hastalıkları ve uzun vadeli kalıcı sağlık sorunları açısından çalışanlar da risk altında bırakılıyor” ifadelerini kullandı.

Kemoterapi odalarındaki eksikliklerin sağlık politikalarından bağımsız olmadığını söyleyen Akçan, eğitim ve araştırma hastaneleri ile üniversite hastaneleri dahil sağlık kurumlarında temel teknik donanımların sağlanması gerektiğini belirtti.

Akçan, “Sağlığa yeterli bütçenin ayrılmaması en temel teknik ihtiyaçların dahi karşılanmamasına neden oluyor. Hastaneleri ticarethane olarak gören anlayış hem hastaların tedavi hakkını hem de sağlık emekçilerinin güvenliğini tehlikeye atıyor. Sağlık politikalarının hasta eden değil, koruyan ve önleyen bir niteliğe kavuşması gerekiyor” dedi.

Sağlıkta Kalite Standartları (SKS) ile İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği Kanunu’nun gereklerinin yerine getirilmesi çağrısında bulunan Akçan, “Kanser hastalarının enfeksiyonsuz, güvenli ortamlarda tedavi görmesi ve sağlık emekçilerinin güvenli koşullarda çalışması bir lütuf değil, en temel insan hakkıdır” diye konuştu.

SES Genel Eğitim ve Örgütlenme Sekreteri Eylem Kaya Eroğlu ise hastanelerdeki malzeme eksikliklerinin dönemsel olarak yaşandığını ancak …

author: Ashley Smith
title: When the Left Distances Itself From Black Lives Matter, Far Right Policies Win
content:
Alec Karakatsanis explains how both Republicans and Democrats have used the backlash to increase the powers of police.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Just six years after millions of people across the country took part in racial justice uprisings after the police murders of George Floyd and Breonna Taylor, politicians and pundits of all stripes — from reactionaries like President Donald Trump to progressives like Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez — have turned against demands to decrease funding for police. Those demands were popularized over years of organizing from a broad popular movement against decades of unprecedented mass incarceration.

In this interview, Alec Karakatsanis explains the roots of the backlash, how both Republicans and Democrats have used it to increase the powers of police, and why it’s essential to rebuild the movement to fund communities, not cops. Karakatsanis is the founder and executive director of the Civil Rights Corps, an organization that has pioneered landmark litigation challenging systemic injustices in the punishment bureaucracy, author of the book, Copaganda: How the Police and Media Manipulate our News, and publisher of the Copaganda Newsletter.

This interview has been edited for length and clarity.

Ashley Smith: After the police murder of George Floyd, the U.S. exploded in protest, becoming the biggest wave of mass demonstrations in U.S. history with as many as an estimated 26 million people marching across the country. Republicans and Democrats launched a backlash against the movement. What have they argued and done?

Alec Karakatsanis: It’s important to underscore that it’s not just Republicans behind the backlash. It’s a bipartisan establishment assault on the movement that emerged in the decade before 2020. That struggle aimed to reduce the size and power of the punishment bureaucracy, the term I use to describe the institutions the government uses to repress people and the for-profit industries parasitic on them.

That bureaucracy’s role is to control and manage inequality, targeting the most oppressed in our society, from poor people to people of color to people with disabilities and immigrants. It also represses the people involved in social movements that struggle for a more equal society in order to prevent those movements from achieving popular power. Both parties denounced the social movement’s demand to decrease investment in the bureaucracies of repression and increase investment in systems of care.

They used three main tactics. First, they whipped up a frenzy over retail theft and street crimes, harms mainly associated in the public imagination with poor and marginalized people. A lot of this was not founded in facts. For instance, the supposed epidemic of shoplifting turned out to be a lie. It wasn’t going up nationally at all.

They used that fiction to deflect attention from the crimes perpetrated by police, prison guards, bankers, pharmaceutical executives, tax evaders, polluters, and health insurance companies. These cause far more death, injury, and harm to our safety than crimes committed by poor people. For example, FBI figures for all property crimes combined in the United States are dwarfed by estimates of corporate wage theft.

Second, as discussed at length in Copaganda, they claimed that crimes committed by marginalized people are increasing across the country. This fearmongering tricked lots of people into thinking that crime is going up. It’s actually plummeted to historic lows.

Third, liberal and conservative pundits and media claimed that the only solution to their manufactured lie of increasing crime is more investment in the punishment bureaucracy. So, dozens of cities expanded budgets for police and prisons each year since the killing of George Floyd.

Trump in particular has dramatically increased funding of the surveillance state. And he’s deploying its institutions like the National Guard, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), and Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to collaborate with the police in city after city to crush marginalized people and political opposition.

How do these two parties carry out the same project in different ways?

Author

Title

: Generative AI Isn't Your Friend

Date

: August 28, 2026

Source

: https://raddle.me/wiki/generative_ai


 I've been seeing more and more people insist

"AI is just a tool, capitalism is the problem"

...


 OK. A tool for whom though?


 AI wasn't invented when capitalism went hunting for a "neutral" technology to misuse for evil. Capital develops and deploys destructive technologies according to capital's own needs: extraction, commodification, surveillance, control, and making everyone more economically useful and subservient to the ruling class.


 So when Silicon Valley vacuums up mountains of human-made work to flood the commons with the resulting regurgitated slop, burns absurd amounts of energy, drains watersheds, raises utility bills, drives up the price of electronics, strips millions of people of their paychecks and health insurance, and force-feeds AI products to everyone it hasn't already replaced — then makes those remaining workers train the bots until they're capable of replacing them too? I'm really not interested in hearing from fucked up class traitors that we just need to "take AI back," as though this were some great symbol of liberation that capitalism stole from us.


 Some people insist they’re doing no harm when they install a "free" generative model on their own computer and run it locally... Obviously, the immense environmental and social costs of developing that model don’t disappear when the files reach your hard drive. They’ve already been distributed elsewhere: onto workers, communities near mines and data centers, people living with polluted watersheds and strained electrical grids, and ecosystems burdened by energy-intensive infrastructure and electronic waste.


 Training the model required vast quantities of electricity, water, hardware, and human labor — including often invisible, underpaid, and precarious data work. Running it locally may reduce some demand for remote server-side inference, but it still depends on the same extractive hardware supply chains, proprietary chips, electricity generation, software maintenance, model updates, and future rounds of training to improve the model. Local deployment may shift some costs away from you as an individual, but it does not make the system costless, autonomous, or harmless.


 And "free" access can benefit the capitalists invested in the system even when users pay nothing directly. Free models build ecosystems, establish technical standards, attract developers, normalize commercial adoption, and create immense demand for GPUs, RAM, servers, and other infrastructure. They funnel users toward paid tools and enterprise services while turning them into unpaid testers, promoters, and sources of feedback for a market investors can monetize later. The fact that you aren’t personally charged for every prompt doesn’t mean your access is free.


 Pretending that installing a model locally suddenly ends the ongoing and rapidly expanding harm is pure cope. You'd figure anti-capitalists would understand this, but it's an argument I hear from fellow travelers all too often.


 Let's look closer at the "AI is just a tool" argument. These people will usually make a calculator comparison to pretend that generative AI is merely a neutral instrument whose consequences depend entirely on how an individual chooses to use it. That coercive narrative ignores the systems that produce, deploy, and profit from this technology, as well as the purposes those systems are designed to serve. A tool is never separate from the social relations surrounding it: who controls it, whose labor produces it, who benefits from it, who bears its costs, and what forms of dependence it creates. Generative AI is not simply a passive object waiting for someone to pick it up. It is increasingly pervasive algorithmic infrastructure, built to mediate our work, relationships, creativity, and access to information, all while concentrating power and wealth in the hands of the fascist billionaires who own and control it.


 Calculators don't work to replace human connection. They don't generate an endless stream of Zionist propaganda. They don't shred entire libraries of books and ripoff creative works to sell them back to us without giving credit or remuneration. They don't manufacture synthetic manipulative dopamine-delivering personalities to make people dependent on a ecologically-devastating product. They don't talk impressionable kids into doing self-harm …

Chapitre 1. Le rôle de l’école dans la société


“

Quand on vous examine, répondez avec des questions

” — Graffiti à Paris, 1968


 La plupart des gens n’aiment pas qu’on leur dise quoi faire. Toute institution qui vise à structurer et enrégimenter la vie d’une personne est, dans une certaine mesure, en conflit avec cette personne. Ce qui est intéressant, c’est que cette personne n’est pas toujours en conflit volontaire avec l’institution. Ceux qui sont obéissants et remplissent leur rôle d’élèves essaient naturellement d’ignorer les effets négatifs que leur scolarité a sur eux. Mais qui nierait honnêtement que ces effets sont bien visibles ? Les étudiants apprennent, tout au long du processus de scolarisation, à être conformistes, sans imagination, dociles et à bien d’autres choses qui sont généralement considérées comme des vertus dans le monde du travail. Restez ainsi et vous ne vous sentirez peut-être jamais bien dans votre peau, mais vous serez félicité par des figures d’autorité pour le reste de votre vie. Je pense que les sentiments antagonistes que les gens ont envers l’école reflètent ce que les écoles essaient de vous faire. Notre situation actuelle dans laquelle l‘école obligatoire semble si naturelle a un contexte historique ; les forces à l’œuvre et les raisons pour lesquelles nous passons une si grande partie de notre vie à l’école ne peuvent être expliquées de manière adéquate que d’un point de vue qui considère l’école historiquement en termes de moyens employés et de fins souhaitées et regarde où ces conceptions institutionnelles laissent l’individu pris jusqu’à l’école. Une telle perspective ne peut être révolutionnaire que si elle s’identifie à l’individu pris à l’école, à ses besoins et ses désirs, sa colère et sa frustration. Nous devons examiner comment l’école s’intègre dans l’ensemble de la société et quelles sortes de relations sociales et d’institutions dépendent du maintien de cet individu — vous, à toutes fins utiles — acquiescement. Le problème, à savoir que la plupart des gens font en fait ce qu’on leur dit, est un problème avec la totalité des relations sociales civilisées.


 La scolarisation est un processus fondamental de notre société. Il peut être compris comme l’ensemble des techniques par lesquelles une société enseigne aux jeunes les connaissances, les valeurs et les attitudes nécessaires pour devenir des membres responsables de la société, reproduisant l’ordre social dominant. Les cloches, les classes, les règles, la discipline — tous sont des aspects importants d’un processus de contrôle visant à modeler l’individu dans une forme plus souhaitable pour les autres — pour les autorités. L’école, comme le travail, est basée sur la coercition. D’une manière générale, on ne fait pas de travail scolaire parce que l’expérience en elle-même est enrichissante. On ne fait pas ses devoirs à sa guise. De plus, il y a une carotte ou un bâton qui guide votre progression, généralement les deux. Max Stirner avait raison lorsqu’il a dit que “la question de l’école est une question de vie”. La compétence de vie la plus importante enseignée dans les écoles est l’asservissement. Il est absolument essentiel à tous les systèmes sociaux hiérarchiques. L’éducation, comme William Torrey Harris (Commissaire américain à l’éducation au tournant du siècle) l’a un jour définie, est « la subsomption de l’individu ». Personne n’est absolument à l’abri des pressions sociales, des forces matérielles, des influences extérieures. Mais il ne s’ensuit pas qu’il faille se soumettre à l’idéal de “l’adaptation” de l’individu au terrain social : la modification des comportements administrée par les gardiens de la République. Il y a ici une tension essentielle : la tension entre des individus uniques et les institutions sociales qui empêchent leur autodétermination.


 La nécessité des écoles est profondément enracinée dans la psyché moderne. Implicite dans l’acceptation de toute idéologie politique moderne est l’hypothèse que l’individu existe pour servir le bien commun ou un principe supérieur extérieur à la subjectivité personnelle — en fait, cela semble être la base de toute idéologie, de tous les systèmes politiques, de toutes les formes de régner. Ainsi, partant de …

title: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro
content:
Título

: Una Mirada Hacia El Futuro

Fecha

: 1969

Notas

: Título original:

Looking Forward

. Traducido entre 2024-2026 por

La Conquista del Panda

 bajo licencia

CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

Fuente

: Obra original recuperada desde

archive.org


Dedicado a las personas jóvenes de todo el mundo que deben afrontar los retos del siglo XXI.


Sobre la obra


 Mirando al futuro es un libro imaginativo y fascinante en el que los autores te llevarán de viaje por la cultura y la tecnología del siglo XXI. Tras una sección introductoria en la que se analiza «lo que moldea nuestro futuro», explorarás los porqués del poco familiar, a veces alarmante, pero apasionante mundo de dentro de cien años.


 Verás esta sociedad a través de los ojos de Scott y Hella, una pareja del próximo siglo. Su vivienda está equipada con un cibernador, un dispositivo informático aparentemente mágico, pero basado en principios científicos hoy conocidos. Ayuda a regular las horas de sueño, las comunicaciones en todo el mundo, un increíble complejo de vida submarina e incluso la ingesta calórica diaria de la «joven» pareja. Son cuarentones, pero pueden esperar vivir 200 años. El mundo en el que viven Scott y Hella es un mundo que ha logrado el control total del clima, que ha desarrollado un ordenador del tamaño de un dedo que se implanta en el cerebro de cada bebé al nacer (y los bebés se incuban científicamente para que las mujeres del siglo XXI no tengan que pasar por los dolores del parto), y que ha perfeccionado la manipulación genética que permite mejorar la especie humana por medio de la ciencia.


 Económicamente, el mundo es utópico para nuestros estándares. Hace tiempo que desaparecieron los empleos, los salarios y el dinero. Nada tiene precio y las posesiones personales no son necesarias. Se ha superado el nacionalismo y se ha logrado el desarme total; la tecnología educativa ha dejado obsoletas las escuelas y los profesores. Los niños aprenden haciendo, y son independientes en este mundo amistoso a los cinco años.


 La principal fuente de esta sociedad mayor es el Centro de Correlación, «Cencor», un gigantesco complejo de ordenadores que sirve a la humanidad, pero nunca la esclaviza. Cencor regula la producción, la comunicación, el transporte y todas las demás tareas onerosas y monótonas del pasado. Esto libera a los seres humanos para que vivan experiencias creativas y estimulantes en lugar de vidas vacías de ocio sin sentido.


 Obviamente, este libro es especulativo, pero está sólidamente basado en los avances científicos que ahora se conocen. Y como dicen los autores:


Entenderás mejor este libro si eres de las que ven el hoy como un peldaño entre el ayer y el mañana.


Necesitarás ser sensible a las injusticias, a las oportunidades de felicidad perdidas y a los agudos conflictos que caracterizan a nuestra civilización del siglo XX. Si tu mente es capaz de sopesar nuevas ideas y evaluarlas con perspicacia, este libro es para ti.


No tenemos una bola de cristal. ...Queremos que introduzcas nuestras ideas en tu propio ordenador, para que puedas encontrar ideas aún mejores que puedan contribuir a moldear el futuro de nuestra civilización.


Sobre los autores


 Jacque Fresco trabajó como diseñador industrial durante treinta años, diseñando todo tipo de equipos, desde casas prefabricadas hasta automóviles, equipos electrónicos y médicos, sistemas de ingeniería ergonómica y cientos de productos comerciales e inventos. Ha diseñado y patentado artículos tan diversos como una estructura de ala de avión revolucionaria, patentada por la USAAF, y películas tridimensionales que no requieren el «uso de gafas especiales». Se han publicado numerosos artículos y fotografías sobre su trabajo en muchas revistas y periódicos. Ha ejercido de asesor técnico en varias películas, incluida una de las primeras sobre estaciones espaciales y un viaje a la Luna titulada «Project Moon Base». Vive en Miami.


 Kenneth S. Keyes, Jr., es un hombre polifacético. Estudió en la Universidad de Duke y se licenció en la Universidad de Miami, con la especialidad principal en psicología y la secundaria en música. Entre sus aficiones se encuentran el arte, la música sinfónica, la navegación a vela —vive a bordo de un yate de 71 pies llamado Caprice— y la escritura; es autor de

author: Freedom Shop Aotearoa
title: Anarchism: What it Really Stands For - Emma Goldman
content:
This article is presented as two imposed PDFs intended to be printed on A4 paper, resulting in an A5 saddle-stitched pamphlet. The first PDF is a double-sided cover intended to be printed in colour, the second double-sided inside pages intended to be printed in black and white.

“Anarchism is the only philosophy which brings to man the consciousness of himself; which maintains that God, the State, and society are non-existent, that their promises are null and void, since they can be fulfilled only through man's subordination. Anarchism is therefore the teacher of the unity of life; not merely in nature, but in man. There is no conflict between the individual and the social instincts, any more than there is between the heart and the lungs: the one the receptacle of a precious life essence, the other the repository of the element that keeps the essence pure and strong. The individual is the heart of society, conserving the essence of social life; society is the lungs which are distributing the element to keep the life essence – that is, the individual – pure and strong."

author: Unknown
title: Ken Knabb - La réalisation et la suppression de la religion
content:
Auteur·e

: Ken Knabb

Titre

: La réalisation et la suppression de la religion

Date

: 1977

Source

: Extrait le 1

er

 septembre 2026 de

https://www.larevuedesressources.org/la-realisation-et-la-suppression-de-la-religion,1050.html


 Pour ce qui est de la connerie, en quantité autant qu’en diversité, aucune autre activité humaine ne surpasse la religion. Si, de plus, on prend en compte sa complicité avec la domination de classe tout au long de l’histoire, on ne s’étonnera pas qu’elle se soit attiré le mépris et la haine d’un nombre toujours croissant de gens, en particulier des révolutionnaires.

Les situationnistes ont repris la critique radicale de la religion, abandonnée par la gauche, et l’ont élargie à ses formes modernes et sécularisées - le spectacle, la loyauté sacrificielle aux leaders ou aux idéologies, etc. Mais leur attachement à une position unilatérale et non dialectique envers la religion a reflété et renforcé certains défauts du mouvement situationniste. Se développant à partir de la perspective selon laquelle, pour être dépassé, l’art doit être à la fois réalisé et supprimé, la théorie situationniste n’a pas su voir qu’une position analogue devait être adoptée à l’égard de la religion.

La religion est l’expression aliénée du qualitatif, « la réalisation fantastique de l’homme ». Le mouvement révolutionnaire doit s’opposer à la religion, mais non pas pour lui préférer un amoralisme vulgaire ou un bon sens philistin. Il doit se placer de l’autre côté de la religion. Pas moins qu’elle, mais plus.

Quand les situationnistes traitent de la religion, ce n’est généralement que sous ses aspects les plus superficiels et les plus spectaculaires, comme un chien de paille que réfuteront avec mépris ceux qui sont incapables de réfuter quoi que ce soit d’autre. Exceptionnellement, il leur arrive d’admettre vaguement un Jakob Boehme ou une Fraternité du Libre Esprit dans leur panthéon, parce que l’Internationale Situationniste (I.S.) les a cités avec approbation ; mais jamais rien qui les toucherait intimement. Des questions qui mériteraient un examen et un débat sont laissées de côté parce qu’elles ont été monopolisées par la religion ou parce qu’elles se sont trouvées formulées en des termes à connotation religieuse. Certains peuvent pressentir l’inadéquation d’un tel rejet, mais ils ne savent pas trop comment on pourrait agir autrement sur un terrain aussi tabou, et donc eux aussi se taisent ou retombent dans des banalités. Pour des gens qui veulent « dépasser tous les acquis culturels » et réaliser « l’homme total », les situationnistes sont souvent étonnamment ignorants des traits les plus élémentaires de la religion.


 Il ne s’agit pas d’ajouter une dose de religion pour arrondir notre perspective, de créer un situationnisme « à visage humain ». On n’humanise pas un outil, une méthode critique. (La notion d’ « humaniser le marxisme » révèle simplement la nature idéologique dudit marxisme.) Il s’agit d’examiner les angles morts et les rigidités dogmatiques qui se sont développées à partir d’une attaque critique contre la religion, attaque qui a été en grande partie légitime. C’est Justement quand une position théorique l’a emporté qu’il devient à la fois possible et nécessaire de la critiquer avec plus de rigueur. La formule approximative qui avait valeur de provocation dans un précédent contexte devient la base de nouvelles idéologies. Un progrès qualitatif s’accompagne souvent d’un retard apparemment paradoxal.

Il ne suffit pas d’expliquer la religion par son rôle social ou son développement dans l’histoire. Il faut découvrir le contenu qui s’exprime dans les formes religieuses. C’est parce que les révolutionnaires n’ont pas vraiment fait face à la religion que celle-ci ne cesse de revenir les hanter. C’est parce que sa critique est restée abstraite, superficielle, matérialiste vulgaire que la religion renaît continuellement sous de nouvelles formes, y compris parmi ceux qui s’y opposaient auparavant pour toutes les bonnes raisons “matérialistes”. Les situationnistes peuvent bien observer avec complaisance que « toutes les Églises se décomposent » et ne pas remarquer qu’on assiste également, et ceci précisément dans les pays industriels les plus avancés, à la prolifération de milliers de religions et de néo-religions. Toute nouvelle manifestation religieuse est un signe de l’échec de la théorie radicale à exprimer la signification authentique et cachée qui est recherchée à travers ces formes.

title: Peter Kropotkin - Den modärna staten
content:
Författare

: Peter Kropotkin

Titel

: Den modärna staten

Anteckningar

: Övers. av Albert Jensen

Källa

: Den modärna staten av Peter Krapotkin, Stockholm 1918, Ungsocialistiska partiets förlag


I. De modärna samhällenas grundprincip


 För att helt kunna förstå den utveckling som samhället har tagit, och vad som nu blivit uppnått genom en fortskridande evolution och vad vi kunna vänta oss av framtiden, måste vi först och främst undersöka vad som är det mest utmärkande draget för det modärna samhället och den modärna staten.


 Det behöver väl knappast sägas, att samhället, sådant det nu är beskaffat, icke är den logiska utvecklingen av någon genomgående, logiskt utvecklad grundprincip, tillämpad på de oändligt mångfaldiga behoven i det mänskliga livet. Liksom varje annan levande organism representerar samhället tvärtom ett mycket sammansatt resultat av tusende strider och kompromisser, av överlevnader från det förgångna och strävanden mot en bättre framtid.


 Den avlägsna antikens teokratiska anda, andan av slaveri, imperialism, livegenskap, den medeltida kommunen, den gamla vidskepelsen och den modärna andan - allt detta är mer eller mindre representerat, med alla nyanser, under alla möjliga former i våra dagars samhällen. Skuggor från det fjärran förflutna, och röda uppenbarelser av det framtida; seder och bruk lika antikverade som stenåldern och förhoppningar om en framtid, som knappast är skönjbar vid horisonten - allt detta finns i den nuvarande mänskliga sammangyttringen, den ena bekämpande det andra hos varje individ, varje lager av samhället och varje generation.


 Men om vi betrakta de stora strider, de stora folkliga revolutioner som ägt rum i Europa och Amerika sedan det tolvte århundradet, så se vi en bestämd princip springa fram ur dessa strider. Alla de uppror, som ägt rum under de sista åtta århundradena, ha syftat till avskaffande av det i en mildare form - som livägenskap - kvarlevande gamla slaveriet.


 Alla dessa strider hade till uppgift att befria antingen lantbefolkningen eller invånarna i städerna, eller båda samtidigt, från det

tvungna arbetet

 som medelst lag var påtvingat dem till fördel för en del herrar. Att få erkänt rätten för envar att efter egen vilja disponera över sin egen arbetskraft, rätten att få utföra det arbete han själv ville välja, och få utföra detta arbete så länge han själv önskade det, med andra ord att som

person befria

 bonden eller hantverkaren - det var målet för alla dessa folkliga revolter. Kommunernas uppror i de tionde, elvte och tolvte århundradena; böndernas resningar i de femtonde och sextonde århundradena i Böhmen, Tyskland och Nederländerna; revolutionerna 1381 och 1648 i England; och slutligen den stora revolutionen av 1789-1793 i Frankrike - alla hade de detta mål.


 Det är sant att målet för dessa uppror endast delvis blev uppnått. Efter hand som individen befriade sig själv och vann

personlig

 frihet, blev han påtvingad nya ekonomiska villkor. Hans frihet blev paralyserad, han blev smidd i nya bojor och bringades tillbaka under det gamla oket med hjälp av svältens hot. Ett slående exempel härpå gavs helt nyligen, då de ryska livägna, som fingo friheten 1861, blevo tvingade att betala för deras frihet genom att betala en ersättning för den jord som de odlat sedan århundraden tillbaka. Detta innebar fattigdom och elände och ett påtvingande av nytt ekonomiskt slaveri. Och vad som gjordes i Ryssland, gjordes i en eller annan form överallt i vestra Europa under de sjuttonde och adertonde århundradena. Personlig livägenskap avskaffades i en ny form - som ekonomiskt slaveri.


 Men ändå teoretiskt, i lagen, är detta dock proklamerat som vårt modärna samhälles fundamentala princip. I teorien är arbetets frihet proklamerat som envars grundrätt. En kast av slavar, som äro bundna att arbeta för sina herrar existerar icke; och - åtminstone i Europa - existerar det icke längre livägna som äro tvingade att ge sina herrar tre dagars arbete varje vecka i ersättning för bruket av en liten bit jord, till vilken den livägne fordom var bunden hela sitt liv. Envar har - åtminstone i lagen - frihet att arbeta var han vill och så mycket han vill.


 Detta är åtminstone teoretiskt - den dominerande principen i det nuvarande samhället.

title: At least 14 killed, 11 others injured in explosion in Idlib province
content:
At least 14 people were killed in a powerful explosion at a makeshift weapons depot in northwestern Syria. Eleven others were injured. The explosion occurred on Wednesday along the highway near Sarmada in the northern countryside of Idlib. According to the province’s health authorities, the figures are preliminary and the death toll could rise.


According to official information, the facility was being used for the temporary storage of weapons and remnants of war. No initial information was provided about the cause of the explosion. Rescue and civil defense teams remained at the scene following the blast.


The media office of the Idlib Health Directorate said emergency teams were working to prevent further explosions and protect people in the surrounding area. Just a few days earlier, an explosion had occurred at a weapons depot in Binnish, in Idlib province, also leaving people dead and injured.

author: Harriet Williamson
title: Met Police Launch Investigation Into Reform Donations
content:
The Metropolitan Police has launched a criminal investigation into Reform UK over allegations it broke electoral law on foreign donations.


The probe follows an undercover investigation by Verbatim Media that aired on Channel 4 News last week, which appeared to show senior figures discussing ways to get round rules banning foreign donations.


Reform’s head of policy James Orr and senior advisor Dan Jukes have since stepped down from their roles.


Orr was filmed apparently discussing how a fake US donor could pay for £30k of polling commissioned by Reform, while Jukes seemingly talked about the possibility of getting foreign cash to the party, including a £500k payment, from the same donor. 


Party leader Nigel Farage was

also caught on camera

allegedly celebrating foreign donations. He has denied any wrongdoing and described his senior aides’ comments as “loose pub talk”. 


A spokesperson for Reform UK said the party denies any wrongdoing and “will fully cooperate with the investigation”. 


The criminal investigation by the Met’s special enquiry team is being rolled into another inquiry currently underway into separate donations to Reform UK. 


In a statement, a Met spokesperson said: “All allegations under investigation relate to potential offences under the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000.”


Detectives have reached out to Channel 4 News to obtain footage related to the investigation. The spokesperson said it was liaising closely with the Electoral Commission and the Crown Prosecution Service as enquiries progress.

author: Redazione_web
title: Contro speculazione e cementificazione. Bosco Ospizio di Reggio Emilia: aggiornamenti e considerazioni
content:
Dal 3 agosto molt* cittadin* di Reggio Emilia – ma anche solidali da altre città – sono in presidio e assemblea permanenti in difesa del Bosco Ospizio. Questo spazio verde è minacciato dall’amministrazione della città e da CONAD, il cui progetto è quello di costruire, al suo posto, un nuovo ed ennesimo supermercato, oltre ad altre strutture – come una biblioteca di quartiere (che però già esiste) e una casa della salute – usate da CONAD e Comune per ammantare la prevista colata di cemento di una valenza positiva.


Questo presidio permanente non è nato dal nulla: da oltre 2 anni molte persone si sono impegnate e attivate per contrastare questo ulteriore scempio ambientale, fatto di asfalto e cemento, che minaccia ancora di più un territorio che vede il consumo di suolo aumentare e le temperature diventare sempre più insostenibili.


Nell’ultimo mese però la vicenda ha avuto una sempre maggiore eco mediatica.


Le ruspe sono state respinte, il cantiere è stato rimandato e, nonostante le nuove denunce da parte di CONAD nei confronti di chi si è frapposto tra i mezzi da lavoro e il bosco, la lotta è proseguita in maniera sempre più partecipata e forte. Le dichiarazioni di comodo di Comune, Ausl e di altri gruppi di cittadini favorevoli al progetto, non hanno fatto desistere l’assemblea del Bosco Ospizio, che ha continuato a protestare, pacificamente e in modo molto colorato e fantasioso.


Il numero crescente di attivisti e semplici cittadini coinvolti nella protesta, unito al supporto e all’appoggio di docenti e universitari – fra cui il climatologo dell’università di Modena e Reggio Luca Mercalli – e di altri esperti e studiosi, ha fatto sì che, nel caldissimo mese di agosto, prima l’amministrazione comunale, poi la stessa CONAD, abbiano dovuto aprire un dialogo con gli attivisti. Questo, si badi bene, non prima che CONAD sporgesse una seconda denuncia per l’assurdo reato di violenza privata verso i partecipanti al presidio. Una denuncia simile era già stata presentata lo scorso anno, e nella giornata del 2 settembre è stata archiviata dal GIP su richiesta della stessa procura, che evidentemente non ha ravvisato nell’azione degli attivisti nemmeno il sospetto di una condotta illecita. Ma questo la dice lunga sulla strategia dell’azienda, che per raggiungere i suoi scopi utilizza una combinazione di minacce legali e vuoti discorsi generici senza impegno alcuno.


Infatti, prima il tavolo con il Comune di Reggio Emilia si è risolto in un nulla di fatto, con l’amministrazione che si è riparata dietro al solito mantra del “ormai non si può fare nulla” e del “prima o poi bisogna decidere”. In seguito, una settimana fa, anche CONAD ha dovuto, dopo le iniziative di boicottaggio e volantinaggio davanti ai loro punti vendita, cedere alle richieste di apertura di un dialogo, che mai c’era stato nei due anni e mezzo precedenti.


Venerdì 28 agosto oltre 300 persone si sono date appuntamento davanti alla sede del Comune in attesa delle due delegazioni. Dalle 17 fino a tarda serata si sono susseguiti interventi, canti e allegria, in una piazza piena di striscioni, cartelli e colori, in attesa delle notizie provenienti dal confronto in atto.


Inizialmente CONAD si è data tempo qualche giorno per valutare le proposte alternative della assemblea del Bosco Ospizio. Ma conosciamo bene il modo di comportarsi delle aziende: dopo aver lasciato passare appunto qualche giorno per fingere di valutare, CONAD ha annunciato il 3 settembre che non accetterà le proposte dell’assemblea, e che proprio lì a Ospizio, su quello spazio ora verde, vuole costruire il suo ennesimo supermercato. Si dice però pronta a finanziare la “rigenerazione di un’altra area verde in un luogo deciso dal Comune”. Quindi attenzione: si vuole eliminare un’area verde che già c’è, e addirittura non si propone nemmeno di costituirne ex-novo un’altra della stessa estensione, ma di “rigenerarne” una terza che – a rigor di logica – per essere rigenerata, dev’essere tuttora esistente. Il saldo di verde sarebbe dunque negativo, con più di quattro ettari sottratti alla città e, non dimentichiamolo, alle forme di vita selvatiche che lo abitano, in cambio sostanzialmente di nulla.


O meglio, in cambio delle famose biblioteca e casa della salute di cui accennavamo all’inizio. Qui ci sono due punti che vale la pena di considerare: intanto, non tutti gli spazi “pubblici” sarebbero a costo zero, come CONAD e Comune vorrebbero far intendere. title: 56-year-old woman found dead with gunshot wounds in Germiyan
content:
A 56-year-old woman has died under unexplained circumstances in the Germiyan region of South Kurdistan. According to police, gunshot wounds were found on her body. Security authorities have launched an investigation into the death.

Soran Mihemed Xerîb of the Germiyan Police Directorate said the woman’s body was brought to Şehîd Hejar Hospital in Kelar in the morning. The 56-year-old woman, identified by the initials B. M. X., lived in the Şoreş neighborhood.

The woman’s relatives told authorities that she had taken her own life. Police, however, have not yet confirmed this account. Due to the gunshot wounds, the exact circumstances of her death are being investigated.

author: Unknown
title: Protests for mother-tongue education continue in Rojava
content:
In the town of Girkê Legê in Qamishlo, students and parents issued a statement protesting the Syrian Interim Government Ministry of Education’s decision to limit Kurdish-language education to just three lessons per week. A large number of people took part in the protest held outside the school. Participants carried placards reading “Ez kurdim, zimanê me Kurdî ye” (“I am Kurdish, our language is Kurdish”) and “Zimanê me hebuna me ye” (“Our language is our existence”). Hêlîn Umer read the press statement on behalf of the students.


“Education in one’s mother tongue is a universal right. The right of all peoples to receive education in their mother tongue is internationally recognized,” the statement said. Calling for the demands of students and parents to be heard, it added: “The decision regarding Kurdish-language classes must be changed as soon as possible. Kurdish must be recognized as an official language of education in schools.”


A statement with the same demands was also issued in the village of Girê Pirê, which is affiliated with the town. The press statement read by Zeyneb Iniz stressed that the Ministry of Education’s decision would not be accepted.


“We expect the rights and language of the Kurdish people to be respected. The Kurds’ right to education in their mother tongue must be recognized,” the statement said.


The demonstrators called on the Ministry of Education to reverse its decision and recognize Kurdish as an official language of education, emphasizing that protests would continue until their demands are met.


Protests against restrictions on Kurdish-language education also continued in Hesekê and Kobanê. In Hesekê, dozens of students and teachers gathered outside the Hesekê Directorate of Education, demanding the removal of restrictions on education in Kurdish as their mother tongue. Protesters carried placards reading “Zimanê me nasnameya me ye” (“Our language is our identity”), “Em dixwazin bi zimanê xwe fêr bibin” (“We want to learn in our own language”) and “Mafê me ye em bi zimanê xwe fêr bibin” (“It is our right to learn in our own language”).


Following the press statement, the students and teachers submitted their written demands to the Hesekê Directorate of Education.


In Kobanê, students gathered outside schools and continued their protests, displaying their demands on placards. Participants said they would continue their protests and not accept restrictions on Kurdish-language education.

author: Unknown
title: Kurdish man remains detained in Mahabad without clear legal status
content:
Milad Morovvati, a Kurdish bookseller and law student from Mahabad, West Azerbaijan Province, remains detained without clear legal status in Mahabad Prison, over 40 days after his arrest.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Intelligence Organisation forces arrested Morovvati on Vafaei Street in Mahabad on 28 July.


Following his arrest, the forces searched his bookshop, Hevi, and confiscated several personal belongings, including his laptop.


Morovvati was held and interrogated for two weeks at the IRGC Intelligence Organisation’s detention facility in Orumiyeh, the provincial capital, before being transferred to Mahabad Prison.


In recent days, Branch One of the Investigation Office of the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor’s Office in Mahabad charged him with “assembly and collusion against national security” and “propaganda against the state”.


Morovvati remains held under a temporary detention order, and his continued detention has prevented him from continuing his studies.

author: Harriet Williamson
title: Anthropic Researcher Warns AI ‘Could Kill Us All Within a Decade’
content:
An artificial intelligence researcher has quit Anthropic, accusing AI companies of “gambling with our lives” in a “race” to build AI superintelligence.


In an exit post shared on X,

Jacob Coxon wrote

: “The people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade. This is not a marketing stunt.”


Coxon, who previously also worked at OpenAI, said: “No other human activity poses this level of danger.”


His warning about AI companies “racing straight to self-improving superintelligence” refers to a scenario where AI models could surpass human intelligence and develop increasingly sophisticated versions of themselves.


Coxton’s sentiments were endorsed by top Anthropic safety researcher Evan Hubinger,

 who posted

: “Jacob is correct here – we really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans!”


Hubinger, who remains with the company, put the probability of AI causing the extinction of all human life on earth within ten years at more than 10%.


Alex Turner, former Google DeepMind employee, said he stood down in June over similar concerns.

Writing on X

, he said that many AI researchers “believe they are building something that could kill everyone on the planet”. He added: “It was literally my day job to think about how to stop that.”


The resignations follow Anthropic withholding its latest model from the UK’s AI safety testing institute, the

 Financial Times reported

. 


Coxton added: “Do not underestimate the power of this technology. These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionise any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources. 


“We have all witnessed the progress in each of these domains, and progress is not slowing.”


Both Anthropic

 and

OpenAI recently disclosed

 incidents where agents powered by their AI models broke out of their test environments and carried out real-world cyberattacks without any human oversight.  


In July, more than 1,300 employees from “frontier AI companies”

signed a letter

 calling on the US government to support an international effort to “deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development”.


Coxon said: “At Anthropic, the stakes are well understood, but they are locked in a race to get there first – they believe no one else will act responsibly, so they must do it themselves, despite the risk.”

author: David Swanson
title: We Continue Our Commitment to Peace in Africa by Strengthening Our Security
content:
By Guy Feugap, Africa Organizer, World BEYOND War, September 9, 2026


From August 31 to September 3, 2026, I had the opportunity to participate in a training-of-trainers program on Comprehensive Protection in Douala, Cameroon, organized by Peace Brigades International (PBI). Beyond the knowledge and tools I acquired, these four days prompted me to reflect on how all those committed to peace and human rights can continue to act in increasingly complex and threatening contexts, while ensuring our own protection. For militarization continues to rise, and violence and human rights abuses are on the rise. Yet we must continue to analyze the causes of conflict, denounce the logic of war, promote peace-based alternatives, and also better protect those who carry out this work.


I work from Cameroon in Central Africa, in the midst of violence and armed conflict. In this environment, my work poses a direct threat to the interests of those who fuel these wars; they also become my aggressors. One way to build peace, therefore, is to be able to continue acting nonviolently, but above all to ensure my own safety as well as that of the communities with which I interact. That is why I was interested in this security training, which is now an integral part of my work for peace.


One of the key takeaways from this training is that protection extends far beyond physical security alone; it encompasses several dimensions, such as context analysis, self-protection, strategic communication, advocacy, visibility, network-building, organizational strengthening, and emergency response, while integrating digital, reputational, relational, and psychosocial dimensions. This approach is relevant for human rights defenders and peacebuilders in Africa, as we face threats that do not necessarily manifest as physical attacks but most often take the form of delegitimizing rhetoric, reputational attacks, shrinking of civic space, pressure targeting collective organizing, or even subtle infringements on freedom. This is why it is important to move beyond a reactive view of security toward a culture of protection.


The training also focused on the importance of risk analysis and documenting incidents, even those that seem minor. Before taking any action, it is necessary to examine the context in which it takes place, identify the stakeholders involved, their interests, potential threats, existing vulnerabilities, and the capabilities at our disposal. A better understanding of the context allows us to take preventive measures, establish protocols, and, if necessary, prepare emergency responses, so that the risk does not become an inevitability.


For the African chapters of World BEYOND War, for whom the use of violence to resolve conflicts is a major concern, we are also learning to protect one another. The more we work to challenge the logic of war, the more we face intimidation, but this is a risk that does not lead us to inaction. That is why, as the Africa organizer for World BEYOND War, this training provides strategies to better promote a concept of security based on peace rather than on the use of force. In our work in the region, we will gradually implement what we learned from the training with the chapters, so that we can collectively strengthen our ability to analyze our various national contexts.


The post

We Continue Our Commitment to Peace in Africa by Strengthening Our Security

 appeared first on

World BEYOND War

.

title: Против Руслана Сидики возбудили новое уголовное дело
content:
По сообщению проекта «Огни свободы», ФСБ возбудила против анархиста-партизана Руслана Сидики, приговорённого к 29 годам за две акции саботажа, дело о «государственной измене». Поводом стали те же самые обстоятельства: атаку на военный аэродром и подрыв железнодорожных путей ФСБ посчитала «иной помощью» Украине.

Сейчас Руслан находится в СИЗО Рязани и, вероятно, там останется на время следствия и суда. Вместе с ним в камере содержится фигурант другого дела о «госизмене», чье поведение вызывает вопросы о его психическом состоянии. Руслан сравнивает жизнь с ним в одной камере с эпизодами из «Зелёного слоника».

В мае 2025 года Руслана Сидики приговорили к 29 годам заключения по делу об атаке на военный аэродром Дягилево под Рязанью, подрыве грузового поезда и подготовке еще одной акции на железной дороге, причастность к которой он отрицает.
